title: Power Automate process mining: import star schema (normalised) event data
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly treats the OneLake service principal prerequisite as unconfirmed for normalized import, although the feature guide explicitly requires the linked OneLake prerequisites. The roadmap details, documented import workflow, licensing figures and Fabric control references are supported.

claims.claim: Process Mining can ingest a star schema consisting of an event table plus optional case and lookup tables rather than a single wide table.
claims.quote: you can point Process Mining directly at a star schema—a thin event table plus optional case and lookup tables, linked by foreign keys.

claims.claim: The normalized tables are linked by foreign keys.
claims.quote: a thin event table plus optional case and lookup tables, linked by foreign keys.

claims.claim: Supported OneLake sources include managed Delta tables and loose Parquet or CSV files under the lakehouse Files area.
claims.quote: OneLake / Microsoft Fabric: A lakehouse with managed Delta tables, or loose Parquet or CSV files under the Files/ area.

claims.claim: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 containers with CSV, Parquet or Delta-Parquet folders are supported sources.
claims.quote: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2: A container with CSV, Parquet, or Delta-Parquet folders.

claims.claim: A JSON configuration describes the tables, storage backend and mappings to Process Mining attributes.
claims.quote: dataSource answers "Where is the data and what does it look like on disk?" It declares the storage backend (ADLS Gen2 or OneLake), the file format (CSV, Parquet, or Delta-Parquet), and a list of datasets.
